name: Dr. Althea 345 Relief Serum | Hydrating & Calming Serum with Tea Tree Leaf Water, Ceramide NP & Niacinamide | Barrier Repair & Deep Hydration | 30ml
description:
Restore balance to stressed and sensitive skin with Dr. Althea 345 Relief Serum. Powered by Triple Liposome Technology, this lightweight serum delivers deep hydration, long-lasting soothing care, and barrier repair. Formulated with 32% Tea Tree Leaf Water, Centella Asiatica, Ceramide NP, and Niacinamide, it helps calm irritation, strengthen the skin barrier, refine pores, and leave the skin fresh, smooth, and radiant.

Key Features
Powered by Triple Liposome Technology for deep absorption
Contains 32% Tea Tree Leaf Water to help soothe irritated skin
Ceramide NP helps strengthen the skin barrier
Centella Asiatica helps calm and comfort stressed skin
Niacinamide helps brighten and refine pores
Provides long-lasting hydration without greasiness
Lightweight formula absorbs quickly into the skin
Helps maintain healthy-looking and balanced skin
Leaves skin feeling fresh, smooth, and hydrated
Suitable for all skin types

Product Specifications
Product Type: Hydrating and Calming Serum
Brand: Dr. Althea
Volume: 30ml / 1.01 fl. oz.
Texture: Lightweight Serum
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Finish: Non-greasy

How to Use
Cleanse and tone your skin thoroughly
Apply 2–3 drops to the face
Gently pat until fully absorbed
Follow with moisturizer
Use morning and evening for best results

Material / Composition
Tea Tree Leaf Water (32%)
Ceramide NP
Centella Asiatica Extract
Niacinamide
Panthenol
Hydrating and skin-conditioning ingredients

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Perform a patch test before first use
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
